# Fetch Refactor

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

Related: #880

Split monolithic `FetchExternalities` into context-dependent, smaller interfaces. This is an intro to actually implement Refine Fetch Externalities and/or handling authorization.

## Walkthrough

This PR splits the previous monolithic fetch externalities into context-specific interfaces and implementations: adds FetchContext enum, IIsAuthorizedFetch, IRefineFetch, IAccumulateFetch, and new RefineFetchExternalities and AccumulateFetchExternalities classes; updates Fetch dispatch to respect context and returns null for unsupported kind/context combos; replaces use-sites to construct the new concrete refine/accumulate externalities; removes the old FetchExternalities implementation and its tests; adds new tests for refine/accumulate fetch externalities and updates existing fetch tests to use context-specific mocks; exports refetch-related utilities.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~60 minutes

## Possibly related issues

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#880: Implements splitting IFetchExternalities into context-specific interfaces and introduces Refine/Accumulate fetch externalities, matching the refactor and new classes in this PR.

## Possibly related PRs

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#562: Continues the refactor narrowing pvm-executor fetchExternalities types and adding Refine/Accumulate externalities — strong code-level overlap.  
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#451: Modifies accumulate externalities usage in executor/accumulate invocation, matching changes to construction of accumulate fetch externalities.  
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#390: Prior refactor of the Fetch host-call surface; closely related to the introduced context-specific fetch interfaces and Fetch dispatch changes.
